description: The spreadsheet's context menu surface. It must be rendered as a SIBLING of the layout container: the container is container-type: inline-size (implied contain: layout), which makes it the containing block of a position:fixed menu, and a menu inside the scrolling grid would be clipped. On the mobile layout it is the core TmDrawer bottom sheet (modal: backdrop + focus trap, Escape closes it, 44px menuitem rows in the sans face); on desktop/tablet the anchored menu at the gesture's client point.

parameters.name: Request
parameters.description: The gesture that opened the menu (client point plus the cell or sheet it applies to).

parameters.name: Title
parameters.description: Accessible name of the menu and the sheet's title.

parameters.name: IsMobile
parameters.description: Whether the phone presentation (the core drawer sheet) is used.

parameters.name: Class
parameters.description: Extra CSS class for the anchored desktop menu.

parameters.name: OnSelect
parameters.description: Raised with the selected entry's Id.

parameters.name: OnClose
parameters.description: Raised when the menu should close (outside click, Escape, backdrop, the sheet's close).
